name: @kaditang/agent-payment-guard
description: Pre-pay risk gate for autonomous payment agents — drops onto the x402 payment path itself (@x402/fetch, @x402/axios, x402-fetch, x402-axios), so every 402 is vetted before your agent signs. Blocks payTo swaps, overcharges, budget drains and prompt-injected destinations. Backed by 402Sentinel.
